claims: Issue #481 reports exact rational certificates, one per count, for fifteen new packings at n = 131, 153, 207, 209, 232, 236, 259, 263, 269, 270, 292, 302, 303, 305, 307 and smaller packings at n = 154 and 237 replacing SQUISH's #401 packings, each in squish-submission-2026-10-09/nNNN/nNNN.cert.json with box [0, S]^2 and exact side s_exact; summary.csv repeats each exact fraction.

The three certificates in sources/ (n = 155, 240 and 306, rounding up to 12.9531619520329305, 15.9730095443134852, 17.9635102181210585) are earlier unfiled SQUISH packings that pieces were taken from; the source does not offer them as records.

The source reports that SQUISH's exact Fraction checker and David Ellsworth's check_packing.py at epsilon 1e-50 accept all seventeen, that each certificate was drawn from a 60-digit contact solution with clearance 1e-32 (about 1e-14 at n = 263 and 292), and that no KKT, interval, local-optimality or optimality evidence is given. These are author reports.
